ideas.title: Investigating potential fraud in Minnesota's Department of Human Services
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent reports of potential fraud within the department and examine the proposed changes to combat it.
questions: What are the specifics of the potential fraud?
How will the proposed changes affect the department?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and hold those in power accountable. I recommend starting with a thorough review of the department's financial records and interviewing key officials.
